quickref.status: 2013 launch default; beta name 'Grrnade Launcher'; 2026 unconfirmed (Steam screenshot capture date unknown)
quickref.look: Fat octagonal cylinder launcher on right forearm: white riveted panels framed in orange (#E58D2B lit), black octagonal muzzle, black ribbed hose arcing over the top, small orange fins; ~0.6x Oliver long
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-auto lob in an arc; glowing white-yellow ball (#FBFDDE core) with a fiery yellow-orange comet trail (#ECB235); a golden orb forms on the muzzle during reload [Observed low-res]; 750 u/s
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on contact into a big bright golden orb blast, 45-70 explosive, AoE 125/250, knockback on airborne targets, high self-damage risk [Fan-wiki]; blast not clearly observed

quickref.status: 2013 launch, 110,000 J; beam effect added in a later update; seen in official 2026 playtest highlights and fan 2026 closed test
quickref.look: Long black slab arm-gun on right forearm with orange frame rails and white end panels; often held muzzle-up; ~0.65x Oliver long
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 1 s gold charge glow, then a hitscan pencil-thin lemon-yellow beam (#EDDC31-#F7E95C, pale core #F9F2A3) with a spiky gold muzzle flare; 1 shot per 3 s reload
quickref.impact_end_result: Large gold-white explosion with spark starburst and a dim light wave; 75-90 explosive, AoE 90/220 [Fan-wiki]; spark starburst observed on official banner

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.3 (Sep 27 2013), 60 Gas; BBH Ultimate per wiki; 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Short wide orange/white cylinder with grey hex muzzle and cyan light ring; in-game shows white fins with glowing cyan panels (fold-out per concept); ~0.5x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Chargeable energy shotgun: 2 uncharged shots or one full-charge golden burst; particles converge while charging, orbs of light at the tip when full [Fan-wiki]; short yellow-gold streaks observed
quickref.impact_end_result: No AoE; yellow-white spark burst on the hit target [Observed low-res]; 45 uncharged / 140 charged

quickref.status: Added v2.7 (Jan 23 2014); 40-round clip in 2015 HUD; possibly 75 at launch; 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Wide orange-and-silver stepped drum minigun on right forearm, orange end cap with multi-hole port, cyan side window; promo card adds a black multi-barrel cluster and top capsule; ~0.5x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Full-auto with wind-up and wind-down, 0.08 s rate, hitscan explosive bullets [Game text via wiki/Fan-wiki]; tracer look unconfirmed
quickref.impact_end_result: Tiny explosive pops, 5 + 2-4 explosive, AoE 50/100 [Fan-wiki]; not observed

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.7 (Jan 23 2014), 150,000 J; 3-shot clip seen 2014-2021; 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Rounded orange-and-white arm cannon with black octagonal muzzle holding a glowing cyan lens, cyan light strip, small black scope on top; ~0.45x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-auto, instant hitscan 'purple bolt of damaging energy' [Fan-wiki]; bolt not observed
quickref.impact_end_result: No explosion ('What no explosion?' [Game text via wiki]); 50 damage

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.20 (May 29 2015), 100 gas then; SkyVu Facebook post lists '-B1000 Bass Cannon'; 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Dark olive/black cylinder with orange band, dark-blue windows and a speaker/turbine-disc muzzle (white vanes over pale-blue cone); ~0.45x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Continuous fire, 0.25 s per wave, dubstep loop plays while firing; nested octagonal cyan-blue rings (#58CAE3/#4589DC, pale #D8F9FD) fly out, about a bear's torso wide; maroon in one 2.20 clip
quickref.impact_end_result: Rings pop in small blue-white spark bursts; 10 + 10-20 explosive, small AoE 75/150; can blow airborne enemies away

quickref.status: 2013 launch default secondary; REMOVED per wiki note (date and patch unknown); 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Backpack of two stacked orange boxes with black panels, big round speaker-like discs, small dials, white triangle accents; ~0.45x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Hold fire about 3 s (4 s per wiki prose) to self-destruct; moving cancels it; no projectile
quickref.impact_end_result: B-1000 explodes: 200-400 explosive, AoE 200/400, counts as SUICIDE; aftermath shows smoke puff and scattered red and white chunks [Observed low-res]

quickref.status: 2013 launch (beta 'Leap N Destroy'); 100 gas (v2.7) then 70 (2.20) then 60 (wiki); in Steam trailer
quickref.look: Back unit of two riveted white wing-like plates over orange perforated sections on a black spine; vents glow orange after use; ~0.5x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Leaps ~35 degrees at high speed; trailer shows an orange-yellow fireball and comet trail during flight
quickref.impact_end_result: Left arm smashes the ground, golden shockwave like Happy Hour's splash, 70-110 explosive, AoE 125/400; 2.5 s stuck after landing [Fan-wiki]; shockwave not clearly observed

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.3 (beta 'Shield'), 120,000 J; seen in fan 2026 closed test
quickref.look: Black and orange backpack with four white hexagonal pods holding dark round grilles, mirrored white/orange chevrons in the centre
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Activation self-buff, 2 s, 2 charges, 5 s reload; concept says the shield emits from the sides and top when opened
quickref.impact_end_result: Player glows team colour and takes 50% less damage; no overhead icon [Fan-wiki]; glow not observed

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.7, 100,000 J in v2.7; listed as default on the wiki since 2020; 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: White rounded shield-shaped backpack with thick orange outline and segmented white panels
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Activation from the backpack; 2 charges, 1 s cooldown, 3 s reload; no projectile
quickref.impact_end_result: Instant huge harmless white cloud for 5 s that disorients enemies; a near-white in-game frame is consistent with it

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.7, 100 gas in v2.7 (wiki now 60); stub page; 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Orange octagonal cradle on the back holding a glossy white sphere with a cyan liquid band and two cyan lights; never shown detached
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Fires missiles whenever B-1000 fires; 8 missiles then 5 s reload; 1,500 u/s; missiles not confirmed in images

quickref.status: 2013 launch default melee (early name 'Axe Time'); 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Left forearm ends in a grey stone-textured axe head with hammer back and a big curved scratched grey-white blade, orange cuff and fin; NO glow

quickref.status: 2013 launch, 45,000 J; signature promo melee; in Steam trailer and fan 2026 closed test; BBH attack per wiki
quickref.look: Left-forearm gauntlet with three long translucent cyan blades (#2BDCF1, white streaks) and a looping white hose with cyan rings; ~0.6x Oliver
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Upward swinging slash; no projectile; no electric effect documented
quickref.impact_end_result: Trailer kill: gold-white flash and orange streaks, then the target breaks into chunky separate pieces flying upward; 45 damage, +30% special speed

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.21 (Jul 3 2015), 60 Gas, level 5; pink X-guard blade seen in 2026 thumbnails (identity inferred)
quickref.look: Long flat angular silver-grey blade (#A9B6BB) with hot-pink edge trim (#DB0954), thin inner line, dark magenta X-shaped crossguard; longest B-1000 weapon, about Oliver's height
quickref.impact_end_result: 85 damage, highest melee in BBG, +10% health [Fan-wiki]; hit not observed
